I will be arriving in Paris on Sunday. Can you please provide me the the restaurant which serves French cuisine that open on Sunday? Recommend me the restaurant with the best rating and reviews.
            Tell me the restaurant name, rating, address, and the operating hours.

```python
def get_french_restaurant_in_paris():
    # Get all restaurants in Paris
    all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

    # Get the names of the restaurants
    restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]

    # Get the cuisine type of the restaurants
    cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)

    # Filter the restaurants that serve French cuisine
    french_restaurants = [name for name, cuisine in cuisine_types.items() if cuisine == "French"]

    # Get the rating and reviews of the French restaurants
    ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(french_restaurants)

    # Get the operating hours of the French restaurants
    operating_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(french_restaurants)

    # Filter the French restaurants that are open on Sunday
    open_on_sunday = [name for name, hours in operating_hours.items() if "Sunday" in hours]

    # Get the addresses of the French restaurants that are open on Sunday
    addresses = get_restaurants_address(open_on_sunday)

    # Find the French restaurant with the best rating and reviews
    best_restaurant = max(open_on_sunday, key=lambda name: float(ratings_and_reviews[name].split("/")[0]))

    # Print the name, rating, address, and operating hours of the best French restaurant
    print("Name:", best_restaurant)
    print("Rating:", ratings_and_reviews[best_restaurant])
    print("Address:", addresses[best_restaurant])
    print("Operating Hours:", operating_hours[best_restaurant])

get_french_restaurant_in_paris()
```
